  unfold Real.logb
  have h8 : Real.log 8 = 3 * Real.log 2 := by
    have : (8:ℝ) = 2^3 := by norm_num
    rw [this, Real.log_pow]
    ring
  rw [h8]
  field_simp
set y := Real.logb 2 x with hy
have hy_pos : 0 < y := by
  rw [hy]
  exact Real.logb_pos (by norm_num) h₀
rw [hlog8] at h₁
rw [hlog8] at h₁
-- h₁ : logb 2 (y/3) = (logb 2 y) / 3
have hy3_pos : 0 < y / 3 := by linarith
have key : 3 * Real.logb 2 (y/3) = Real.logb 2 y := by linarith
have : Real.logb 2 ((y/3)^3) = Real.logb 2 y := by
  rw [Real.logb_pow]
  push_cast
  linarith
have hcube_pos : 0 < (y/3)^3 := by positivity
have heq : (y/3)^3 = y := by
  have h2 : (1:ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  exact Real.logb_injOn_pos h2 (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr hcube_pos) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr hy_pos) this

  have := heq
  field_simp at this
  linarith
have hy_ne : y ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hy_pos

  have h3 : y * y^2 = y * 27 := by ring_nf; linarith [this]
